Design companies provide bonuses to researched equipment. A country can select:
one each of tank, naval, air, and materiel designers.
With Arms Against Tyranny, these are not available and are instead replaced with military industrial organizations.
With ⟦0⟧, these are not available and are instead replaced with ⟦1⟧.

Bonuses from the tank, naval, and air design companies are only applied to equipment designed ⟦0⟧ the design company was hired. For example, if a tank design company is hired 1 day before a tank is designed, that tank will receive the design company's bonuses permanently. (However, it may be, in some cases, that which bonus is applied is instead determined by which design company was active on the in-game day when the research unlocking the chassis was completed.) If a design company is replaced with another, only the new design company's bonuses will be applied to any equipment designed or researched. A design company's bonuses will never be applied to any equipment that was fully researched ⟦1⟧ to hiring the design company. (Note that this is different from national spirits which modify production cost: those are applied to all equipment produced while they are active, regardless of when it was researched or designed.) Design company bonuses are also applied to ⟦2⟧.
This can be manipulated to maximize useful bonuses by designing tanks, ships, and airplanes at the time when the design company which gives the best bonuses for that type of equipment is hired.
Companies also typically have ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ ⟦2⟧ research speed.
